title: Republic of Chickens
summary: Care for a small republic and meet its rather opinionated chickens.
controls: Use the on-screen hall entrances and controls. Keyboard users can tab between controls.
limitations: The game is visual and progress is stored in this browser.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: A sunlit village square populated by chickens.

title: Wonderlands
summary: Shape an ocean planet, connect rivers, and discover a world of your own.
controls: Choose a terrain tool and paint. Use the game’s zoom and pan controls to inspect the world.
limitations: The game is visual. Saves are browser-local; local-server saves do not transfer automatically to the public site.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: An ocean planet with a painted island, mountains and a river.

title: Squirrel Control
summary: Find ten squirrels in Miss Bunny’s increasingly chaotic cottage.
controls: Select visible squirrels; use the optical magnifier for a closer look. The game supplies pause and comfort settings.
limitations: Finding small illustrated characters is a visual task. Progress and preferences stay in this browser.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: Miss Bunny beside a sofa and squirrels hiding in her cottage.

title: The Last Lantern
summary: Explore Hearthmere and the surrounding wilderness in a single-hero fantasy adventure.
controls: Move with arrow keys or WASD and use the game’s Interact and menu controls. Touch controls are provided by the game.
limitations: The game is visual. Saves are local to the browser; local-play progress does not automatically transfer to the public site.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: Rowan among timber cottages and trees in Hearthmere.
